item.title: Rachel floods Las Vegas after pounding Southern California
item.description: KTLA reported that Rachel was the fourth hurricane in six weeks to send damaging surf to Southern California, following Marie, Polo and Odalys. The station said the developing El Niño pattern is driving the series of storms. The same pattern is producing Kelvin waves that can raise sea level by 6 to 12 inches for a time, which makes coastal flooding worse.
